title: Glaucoma and Cataract Diagnosis from AS-OCT Images Using Ensemble Learning
summary: Addressed clinical ophthalmic imaging challenges by developing an ensemble learning architecture designed for anterior segment optical coherence tomography (AS-OCT) images. Designed a strict leakage-safe cross-validation and feature-fusion pipeline capable of identifying both glaucoma and cataract pathologies concurrently, establishing reliable diagnostic support for clinical practitioners.

image.alt: Clinical AS-OCT ophthalmic imaging scans showing corneal structure and anterior chamber angle.

imageCaption: Dual anterior segment classification ensemble framework

title: EmoMirror: Negotiable Affective Mirroring for Students with Elevated Alexithymia
summary: Individuals with elevated alexithymia experience fundamental hurdles in identifying and articulating their affective states. EmoMirror introduces a negotiable affective mirroring interactive system designed for college students, enabling voluntary, non-coercive visual feedback that fosters cognitive reflection and emotional literacy without imposing rigid diagnostic labels.

image.alt: Negotiable affective mirroring interface illustrating emotional reflection and student interaction.

imageCaption: Affective mirror interface designed for elevated alexithymia

title: EmoType-Zero: Adaptive Fonts to Render the Speech Emotion
summary: Speech carries critical prosodic and emotional nuance that traditional static typography fails to reflect in written communication. EmoType-Zero synthesizes dynamic, adaptive fonts directly from acoustic speech inputs, modulating typography attributes in real-time according to vocal emotional valence and arousal.

image.alt: Dynamic typographic forms synthesized from speech emotion acoustic signals.

imageCaption: Real-time dynamic typographic rendering of speech emotion

title: Touch Through Sound: Ring-Mounted Auditory Pseudo-Haptics for Material Perception
summary: Explores ring-mounted auditory pseudo-haptics to render continuous tactile material perceptions without requiring bulky mechanical actuators. The wearable finger-ring device delivers velocity-modulated audio feedback calibrated to surface roughness and compliance, enriching tactile exploration across virtual and augmented reality environments.

image.alt: Ring-mounted wearable device delivering auditory pseudo-haptics for continuous surface perception.

imageCaption: Continuous material perception via ring auditory feedback

title: AICA-Bench: Holistically Examining the Capabilities of VLMs in Affective Image Content Analysis
summary: Presents a holistic benchmark framework for scrutinizing vision-language models on affective image content analysis. Rigorously assesses multimodal foundation models across subtle visual affective scenarios, revealing current limitations in human-aligned affective understanding and visual sentiment perception.

image.alt: Technical benchmark evaluation pipeline showing multimodal inputs, affective scoring metrics, and vision-language model diagnostic matrices.

imageCaption: Holistic benchmark for affective vision-language models

title: AS-OCT Dataset with Anatomical Structure Segmentation and Scleral Spur Localization in Cataract and Glaucoma
summary: A large-scale, high-quality anterior segment optical coherence tomography (AS-OCT) dataset released for open clinical AI research. Features precise pixel-level anatomical structure segmentations and expert scleral spur landmark localizations across comprehensive cohort scans for cataract and glaucoma screening.

image.alt: Nature Scientific Data anterior segment optical coherence tomography medical imaging scans.

title: Liqo: A Liquid-to-Solid Interaction Metaphor for Exploratory LLM Sensemaking
summary: Introduces a fluid-to-crystallized interactive interface paradigm for exploratory human-LLM sensemaking. Users navigate fluid, ambiguous thought streams before selectively freezing, refining, and reifying validated cognitive clusters into structured, persistent knowledge structures.

title: Writing in Posts and Threads: Collaborative Interactions for Poetry Writing
summary: Investigates structured, non-linear collaborative creative writing workflows. Evaluates how breaking monolithic generative drafts into interactive posts and branching threads empowers co-authors to curate thematic rhythm and metaphoric depth collaboratively.

title: Guessing or Understanding? Probing the Robustness of Large Language Models in Mental Health Sensing
summary: Systematically stress-tests modern foundation models against psychiatric diagnostic benchmarks. Reveals vulnerability to lexical decoys, semantic drift, and superficial heuristic matching, formulating recommendations for clinical safety protocols.

title: Learning Latent Sentiment Boundaries for Fine-Grained Multimodal Sentiment Analysis
summary: Proposes an adaptive geometric boundary formulation in multimodal embedding space, separating subtle valence gradations where acoustic, visual, and lexical cues exhibit contradicting affective polarity.

title: AC-Bench: Do Multimodal Models Truly See Emotion Amidst Textual Interference?
summary: Introduces a diagnostic suite evaluating whether multimodal vision-language models genuinely extract emotional grounding from imagery, or succumb to superficial textual prompt steering and bias when modalities clash.
